title: I just finished the first trailer for my cat kingdom builder and I'm torn between Poki and Steam. Any advice?
author: QuietHeartStudio
selftext:
Hey devs! Solo dev here (Quiet Hearts Studio). This is the first trailer for Crown of Whiskers, a side-scrolling kingdom builder made in Unity. You rule a kingdom of cats and hold back the Gloom, a shadow that rises from the river every night.

I'm stuck on the release plan and would love input from anyone who's shipped on either platform:

• Poki: a free web release with huge reach

• Steam: paid, builds wishlists, and fits with a Kickstarter I'm considering

• Both: the same full game on each

What I'm unsure about:

– Does a free browser version eat into Steam sales, or does the Poki audience actually turn into wishlists?

– Would you put only a slice (like the first island) on Poki and keep the full game for Steam?

Any experience or numbers are welcome. Thanks! 🐾

comments.author: J0rdian
comments.body: I've never heard of Poki in my life. But you should release an Itch/Poki Demo once you have a mostly complete game and steam page set up for wishlists. And can use those other websites to advertise your paid full game on Steam for when it releases in the future, and also just to get more playtesters.

comments.author: One-Area-2896
comments.body:
Getting accepted to Poki isn’t easy. It’s a gated platform and only a few get accepted (like 15%). The whole process might take 2-3 months. They have 5 stages to accept you and you need to hit certain milestones. 

Your game  has all the characteristics of a premium game, I don’t think Poki is the right platform for you. You’ll just lose time. 

I’d aim for steam/itch/epic/gog and any other premium market, then market through TikTok. 

Best of luck with your game!

comments.author: dbojan76
comments.body: do poki first, then steam later

comments.author: Unklemurry
comments.body: You may be inspired by Kingdom Two Crowns.

replies.author: Unklemurry
replies.body: How about adding more cat-themed items instead of bows and swords? something like a meow-meow-punch or a cat scratch.. or... cat tower!

replies.author: QuietHeartStudio
replies.body: There's alot of difference, there are different class of cats, knights,mages and scouts. The river is also another lane where the king can roam through. You also have to maintain your cat needs by providing shelter and fishes. You can fish in the river, farm for catnips. Your goal is to save the dog king who is infected by the gloom

replies.author: QuietHeartStudio
replies.body: The only thing i was inspired by kingdom is to building mechanics, and the water. The rest of the mechanics are cat them based. The cats in the game follow real life cat behaviours.

comments.author: caesium23
comments.body:
Poki eating into Steam sales seems unlikely. The overlap between hypercasual web portal gamers and "real" PC gamers is probably virtually nonexistent.

These are also not equivalent choices. You probably won't be accepted by Poki (I say that because most games aren't, I haven't looked at your game), but $100 guarantees a Steam release. If you're going for web portals, you should also submit to Crazy Games, and you might as well also hit Playgama and Game Distribution while you're at it. Playgama at least should be guaranteed, they have zero quality control.
